svg.title: Proposed Outcome (Not Yet Implemented): Bilingual PDF PII-Masking System Design

g.text: Proposed Outcome (Not Yet Implemented): Bilingual PDF PII-Masking System Design

Post-red-team end-state workflow — Zero-egress intake & 3-way page routing, Tesseract 5 VI/EN OCR, visual CropBox coords, singleton ML-service, human review, destructive redaction & zero-PyMuPDF verification

g.data-desc: Authenticated user uploads PDF (<=25 MB, <=100 pages).
No native PDF parser in external-network api; enqueue PG SKIP LOCKED job.

g.data-label: Deep Intake Gate (Valid, Unencrypted, No Bomb?)
g.data-desc: Isolated scrubbed-env subprocess checks pages <=100, xref <=50k, inflation & pixel caps.
Malformed, encrypted, oversized, or bomb PDFs rejected cleanly.
Atomic move to private storage; original never mutated.
get_texttrace() (3 Tr invisible OCR) + get_image_info(xrefs=True).
set_small_glyph_heights(True), reading order & exact visual CropBox rects.
vie+eng tessdata_best on CPU; ignores untrusted 3 Tr OCR layers.
Native text + embedded image crop OCR; keep native vs ocr provenance.

g.data-label: Normalize Offsets + Stage Safe Preview PNG
g.data-desc: Char-offset-to-token index, visual CropBox coords & staged 150 DPI previews.
Bearer-authenticated singleton ml-service; prevents cross-lang F1 drop.
Production app/ml_service/rules/vi_rules.py + VN NER -> 6 groups.
Production app/ml_service/rules/en_rules.py + EN NER -> 6 groups.

g.data-label: Map Token Offsets -> Visual Rects & Promote Previews
g.data-desc: Atomic SELECT FOR UPDATE tombstone check before moving previews & committing.
Safe PNG viewer + SVG viewBox overlays; optimistic revision_no.
Blocks on failed/unreviewed pages; LOCKED row is never mutated.
Delete text/outlined paths/pixels, decouple XObjects, recursive hidden-data purge, single %%EOF.
pdfplumber + CTM pikepdf/poppler + qpdf; VER-06 runs on native+scanned only if VER-01..05 PASS.
Fail-closed gate; FAIL strictly outranks INCONCLUSIVE.

g.data-label: Discard Temp PDF (SUPERSEDED -> New DRAFT on Residual)
g.data-desc: Never mutates LOCKED; new residuals create revision_no + 1 DRAFT.

g.data-label: Atomic Publish Clean PDF + Verification Report
g.data-desc: SELECT FOR UPDATE tombstone & latest-LOCKED check before publish.
